scenario: An e-commerce platform audits affiliate partner payouts by analyzing the product reviews submitted alongside each affiliate's promotional campaign: the NLP toolkit scores each review text for authenticity (AI-generated vs. human-written), the financial calculator applies a tiered commission formula that discounts payouts for suspected fake reviews, and affiliate-master generates the final payout statement and affiliate link report for each partner.
info_flow: nlp-toolkit analyses each review text and returns isAI flag plus confidence score -> financial-calculator uses the confidence scores to apply authenticity-weighted commission tiers (higher penalty for AI-detected reviews) -> affiliate-master produces the final payout report per affiliate partner.
